version1_0_0_details1: Implemented file management from the main application window: deleting encrypted files, opening files in the file explorer.
version1_0_0_details2: Added the ability to display successful completion of file encryption and decryption operations.
version1_0_0_details3: Added buttons to view encrypted files in the file explorer and return to the home screen.
version0_9_0_details2: Implemented a mechanism to protect user information.
version0_8_0_details1: Implemented saving application settings, including the last selected language and the path to the folder with encrypted files.
version0_8_0_details2: Added the ability to automatically load the last selected language and path to files when the application starts.
version0_7_0_details1: Improved encryption and decryption performance through asynchronous encryption.
version0_7_0_details2: Increased cross-platform support for the application: now it runs on both Windows and Linux operating systems.
version0_7_0_details3: Introduced beautiful animations to enhance the user's visual experience.
version0_6_0_details1: Added the ability to drag and drop files for encryption and decryption from the file explorer to the main application window.
version0_6_0_details2: Added a user guide, author information, and a checkbox to display the password.
version0_5_0_details1: Added the ability to view a list of encrypted files and decrypt them from the main application window.
version0_5_0_details2: Implemented functions to display a list of files, select a file for decryption, and start the decryption process.
version0_4_0_details1: Implemented localization of the user interface into multiple languages.
version0_4_0_details2: Implemented language selection for the interface: English, Russian, Kazakh.
version0_4_0_details3: Added translations for main application messages and buttons.
version0_3_0_details1: Added an interface for entering encryption and decryption passwords.
version0_3_0_details2: Implemented display of error messages for incorrect password input or file decryption errors.
version0_2_0_details1: Added the ability to display the user interface using Electron.
version0_2_0_details2: Created the main application window with the ability to encrypt and decrypt files.
version0_2_0_details3: The application window has a fixed size and loads the main page from the index.html file.
version0_2_0_details4: Event handlers for window closing, application activation, and closing all windows are implemented.
version0_1_0_details1: Added basic functionality for file encryption using the AES-256 algorithm.
version0_1_0_details2: Implemented file encryption and decryption functions.
version0_1_0_details3: Necessary modules for working with the file system, encryption, and inter-process communication are connected.
version0_1_0_details4: Implemented the creation of a derived key based on the user-entered encryption key.
version0_1_0_details5: Encrypted files are saved with the ''.lguard'' extension.

helpinformation4_part3: 2) The name of this function (currently - encryption);

helpinformation4_part5: 4) Fields for entering the password and also for re-entering the password;
